# Resume Auto-Pilot requirements (SYNTHETIC TEST SOURCE)

The tool generates a tailored resume from a master profile and a job description.
It also generates a cover letter for each job description.
A rerun with unchanged inputs must produce identical artifacts.
No claim may appear in any output without a source in the master profile.
The tool runs locally from the command line.
Acceptance: every bullet maps to a profile evidence ID.
Factual integrity takes priority over speed.
Target cost: under USD 0.50 of model usage per job description.
Open question: whether output quality or model cost takes priority has not been decided.
